name: problem row 15
text: Maternal health records fragment across facilities and referrals.

name: problem row 16
text: Paper ANC cards get lost, damaged, or forgotten.

name: problem row 17
text: Receiving hospitals lack accessible, longitudinal pregnancy histories.

name: problem row 18
text: WHO: India accounted for 7.2% of global maternal deaths (2023).

name: problem row 19
text: Users: nurses/ANMs, doctors, and pregnant patients.

name: problem row 20
text: Settings: PHCs, CHCs, district hospitals, private maternity clinics.

name: problem row 21
text: Missing gestational history complicates referral assessment and continuity.

name: solution row 22
text: ₹50 NFC wristband links each registered patient’s pregnancy record.

name: solution row 23
text: Tap scanner; authenticated Doctor Portal retrieves records; <3 seconds reported.

name: solution row 24
text: Doctor Portal: directory, search; 9 care columns (labs/USG/ABHA/visits).

name: solution row 25
text: Upload ANC images; OCR and Gemini AI extract facts.

name: solution row 26
text: RAG suggests fields; nurses confirm, doctors review exceptions.

name: solution row 27
text: Verified data populates columns and strengthens the knowledge base.

name: solution row 28
text: Patient App planned: gestational progress, EDD, diet, 3D fetus.

name: solution row 29
text: Private patient credentials; app and voice remain in development.

name: Evidence sources
text: WHO MMEIG 2025 (2023 estimates); MoHFW ANC standards.

Team and project information supplied by Team WildFire and the referenced final CareLink presentation. India accounted for 7.2% of global maternal deaths in 2023, from WHO MMEIG 2025 estimates: https://pmnch.who.int/docs/librariesprovider9/meeting-reports/mm-report-update.pdf?download=true&sfvrsn=e5d4e25e_1 . MoHFW/NHM guidance specifies a minimum of four ANC checks; local requirements and clinical judgement apply: https://nhm.gov.in/index1.php?lang=1&level=2&lid=218&sublinkid=822 . Team affiliations and clinical validation activities are team-reported. Patient App and Sarvam voice remain in progress.

name: validation row 8
text: Reported tests: 20+ synthetic ANC images; 15 RAG scenarios.

name: validation row 9
text: 3 tested conflict types: 100% detected; limited sample.

name: validation row 10
text: Extraction accuracy: 85-92%; RAG template matches: 80%.

name: validation row 11
text: Unnecessary doctor-review routing: <5% reported.

name: validation row 12
text: ANC flag accuracy: 100% reported; denominator unavailable.

name: validation row 13
text: NFC tap-to-record: <3 seconds; 4 test patients registered.

name: validation row 14
text: Data-entry reduction: ~87% target, 15 to 2 minutes.

name: validation row 15
text: Doctor feedback: handoff enables history before consultation.

name: validation row 16
text: Improvements: confidence badges, danger-sign checklist, 12→3 routine clicks.

name: validation row 17
text: RAG mismatch: doctor review before any verified save.

name: validation row 18
text: Limitations: faded OCR documents; pregnancy-only knowledge base.

name: validation row 19
text: No real-PHC clinical validation; Patient App unfinished.

name: validation row 20
text: Performance figures reported; raw logs and denominators unavailable.

name: safety row 21
text: AI never diagnoses, prescribes, or scores clinical risk.

name: safety row 22
text: Every extraction UNVERIFIED until mandatory human confirmation.

name: safety row 23
text: Danger signs: 0% confidence; mandatory doctor review.

name: safety row 24
text: Low-confidence RAG mismatches route to doctor verification.

name: safety row 25
text: NFC stores link only; authenticated portal authorizes record access.

name: safety row 26
text: Consent and identifier redaction required before cloud AI processing.

name: safety row 27
text: Planned app access restricted to each patient’s own records.

name: safety row 28
text: ₹50 NFC tap reduces literacy barriers; voice in progress.
